note_records.text: **2026-10-14** — .txt targets render verbatim: one fenced block (longer than any backtick run) in a quire-verbatim div, no front matter, insertion-point includes prepend; plain stylesheets keep lines unwrapped at 9pt; named-page pattern documented and verified by render (unnamed @page and :first still apply, verbatim:first overrides, in-flow includes land on their own page). 101 tests green; gate PASS; real PDF renders checked with pdftotext. Not handled: form feeds do not break pages.

items.title: Fail when a profile's required font is missing
items.short_title: Fail when a profile's required font is missing

note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — Profiles can declare fonts (profile and per-variant lists); PDF builds check them with fc-list --format (unescaped families, case-insensitive) once per call during planning and fail with 'profile <config> needs font "X", which is not installed' before anything is written, naming the config that selected the profile (directory name for path-selected or pinned profiles). Checked even under --css/--no-css; HTML skipped; missing/failed/timed-out fc-list warns once and continues. 132 tests green; gate PASS; real builds checked (hyphenated font embedded, missing font fails, HTML builds).

items.title: Render TeX math without a browser or network
items.short_title: Render TeX math without a browser or network

note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — Owner decisions 2026-10-15: approved mathjax@4.1.3 (Apache-2.0, plain 'mathjax' package; mathjax-full is deprecated) as an optional npm dependency, installed by a separate --with-math installer flag (not folded into --with-mermaid; no browser needed). Scratch evaluation: TeX->SVG in Node works offline, ~40ms. Use svg {fontCache: 'local', linebreaks: {inline: false}} - default inline linebreaking splits into multiple SVGs and WeasyPrint shows only the first. Use tex formatError that throws and remove 'noundefined' so undefined macros error. Output has role=img and data-latex but no aria-label/title; add the TeX source as accessible text. mhchem needs an extra font package (out of scope).

items.title: Check for the Mermaid renderer before building starts
items.short_title: Check for the Mermaid renderer before building starts

note_records.text: **2026-10-14** — Mermaid renderer is checked after planning and before any render: a fence in any job's Markdown or applicable includes with the renderer missing fails the call with the install hint naming file and line, and nothing is written. Skips --no-mermaid, inapplicable includes, and top-level indented code. 80 tests green; gate PASS; real PDF run checked (missing renderer: rc=1, no PDFs; --no-mermaid: both PDFs). Known low gaps: indented fences under ~ definition lists, containers inside blockquotes, '> <tab>' fences and indented footnote labels are treated as indented code, so they fall back to the render-time error.

items.title: Let a caller prefer a named profile without requiring it
items.short_title: Let a caller prefer a named profile without requiring it

note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — --prefer-config NAME selects NAME when registered (the --config slot); an unregistered name prints one held warning (s14 message: config file, install hint) and falls through to QUIRE_CONFIG, QUIRE_PROFILE, default, plain. Exclusive with --config (argparse, exit 2); empty name is an error; --letterhead with no fallback profile fails naming the preferred config; registered-but-broken still fails; the warning precedes fallback errors and is silent on --help. 115 tests green; gate PASS; real two-target PDF build checked. Note: --config "" is still silently ignored (pre-existing).

items.title: Reject an empty --config name instead of ignoring it
items.short_title: Reject an empty --config name instead of ignoring it

note_records.text: **2026-10-15** — Found in the s16 gate. resolve_profile_arg tests 'if config_name:', so --config "" is treated as unset: the build silently falls through to QUIRE_CONFIG, QUIRE_PROFILE, the user default, or plain output. --prefer-config "" now fails with 'error: config name is empty' (s16), and profile_from_name already has that message. A render script passing an empty variable to --config should fail the same way. Check: a test for --config "" exiting with that error; QUIRE_CONFIG='' (whitespace-stripped) stays treated as unset.

goals:
- G1 Safe builds: a build never destroys input, and a failed build leaves the existing output intact.
- G2 Reliable runtime: PDF builds work with the venv or a PATH WeasyPrint, and installer flags do what they say.
- G3 Profile management from the CLI: setting a default or removing a profile needs no hand-editing of config.toml.
- G4 Batch builds: build several documents in one call.
- G5 branded-pdf parity: quire does everything branded-pdf does (verbatim text, math, page breaks, per-build overrides, loud font failures), so branded-pdf can become a thin wrapper around it.
non_goals: - Pandoc option passthrough and watch mode are out of scope for this roadmap. Windows support is deferred (see its later item), not excluded.
